answer_2.quote: We compare several methods across four model categories on the M-1 and M-2.0 datasets using accuracy and F1-score

answer_4.quote: To assess automated annotation accuracy, we randomly sample 15-20% of M-1 (444 samples) and M-2.0 (1,489 samples) for manual verification. Three Annotators are selected to classify samples into five modality categories
